units.source_text: 在这之后，罗连从以前圣鲁卡堂提炉童子，变成了栖身于郊外偏僻田园中一个可怜的小乞丐。

en.t: After this, Loren changed from the former thurible-bearing boy of Saint Luke's Church into a poor little beggar sheltering in a remote rural place outside the city.

units.source_text: 尤其他是原来异教人歧视的天主教徒，

en.t: In particular, because he was a Catholic whom the pagans had always despised,

units.source_text: 现在走在街头，不仅会被儿童嘲笑戏谑，而且常常被棍棒石头大攻击。

en.t: now when he walked through the streets, he was not only mocked and teased by children, but was often fiercely attacked with sticks and stones.

units.source_text: 不止如此，他一度患上热病，

en.t: Nor was that all; at one point he came down with a fever,

units.source_text: 在长崎道旁趴了七天七夜，呻吟欲绝。

en.t: and lay beside the road to Nagasaki for seven days and seven nights, groaning as though he were about to die.

units.source_text: 幸亏天主垂爱，苟延残喘，

en.t: Thanks to God's mercy, he barely managed to stay alive,

units.source_text: 在没有钱和粮食的时候，山间的野果和海滨的鱼，也可以当一天的口粮。

en.t: and when he had no money or food, wild fruit from the mountains and fish from the shore could serve as a day's provisions.

units.source_text: 即使是这样，罗连仍然没有忘记圣鲁卡教堂时候的朝夕祷告，

en.t: Even so, Loren still did not forget the morning and evening prayers from his days at Saint Luke's Church,

units.source_text: 他手腕上的念珠，也不改青玉的光泽。

en.t: and the rosary on his wrist still kept its blue-jade luster.

units.source_text: 而且每当夜深人静的识货，

en.t: Moreover, whenever the night was deep and all was quiet,

units.source_text: 他都悄悄走出偏僻的院子，踏着稀稀疏疏的月色，

en.t: he would quietly leave the secluded yard and walk through the thin, scattered moonlight,

units.source_text: 一个人到圣鲁卡教堂门前祷告，默默祈祷天主保佑。

en.t: going alone to the front of Saint Luke's Church to pray, silently asking God for protection.
